title: Tutoring Intake Review Worksheet
subtitle: Capture learner goal, source work, session schedule, and support need; confirm tutor match and progress checkpoint.
description: Tutoring Intake records learner goal, source work, session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint. Tutoring Intake evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tutoring intake evidence-based review when staff must document learner goal and source work. Reconcile session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint before the tutoring intake handoff. Use the intake request, learner work sample, teacher referral if provided, availability calendar, tutor-match rationale, support-route acknowledgment, and first-session plan. For tutoring intake review use, cite source. Match the tutoring intake family or learner wording. Preserve the tutoring intake amendment history and supersession date. Link the tutoring intake source version and meeting notes. Record the tutoring intake learner response and accessibility support. Close the tutoring intake recipient list. Verify tutoring intake documentary provenance. Resolve tutoring intake amendments, superseded wording, and archival distribution for tutoring intake. Ask the assigned tutoring intake reviewer to confirm learner goal against the organization's policy.
